Corollary
[Gradient bound for nonnegative solutions]1. ch16:16.6\group chapter-16↗ gilbarg-trudinger.thm.16.5.interior-gradient-bound Under the hypotheses of Theorem 16.5, if $u\geq 0$, then for every $y'\in \Omega $,

\begin{equation} \tag {16.56} |Du(y')|\le C_1 \exp \{ C_2u(y')/d\} \end{equation}

with $C_1,C_2,d$ as in Theorem 16.5.
